responsibility: Declares the shared compiler-side API and enums for UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, including the classifications used for null-check diagnostics, type-printing style, and value-encoding phase, plus prototypes for UBSan internal-function expansion, metadata creation, type descriptor generation, overflow/bounds/float-cast helpers, and unreachable instrumentation. It is the interface layer used by UBSan instrumentation and the sanitizer optimization pass rather than the implementation of checks itself.
same_name_distinction: Header companion to gcc/ubsan.cc that defines UBSan-specific enums and declares helper/expansion APIs for use elsewhere in GCC. Unlike gcc/ubsan.cc, it is the interface layer and does not implement the UBSan pass, metadata generation, or check insertion.
